mapper.select: select city_id, city_name, province_name, initial_letter, is_hot, status from zjudg_city and status = #{status}and city_name like concat('%', #{cityName}, '%')and province_name like concat('%', #{provinceName}, '%')and initial_letter = #{initialLetter} order by initial_letter, city_name
select city_id, city_name, province_name, initial_letter, is_hot, status from zjudg_city where city_id = #{cityId}
mapper.insert: insert into zjudg_city (city_id, city_name, province_name, initial_letter, is_hot, status, create_time) values (#{cityId}, #{cityName}, #{provinceName}, #{initialLetter}, #{isHot}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from zjudg_master where city_id in #{cityId}) + (select count(1) from zjudg_service where city_id in #{cityId}) + (select count(1) from zjudg_order where city_id in #{cityId}) + (select count(1) from zjudg_booking_slot where city_id in #{cityId})
mapper.delete: delete from zjudg_city where city_id in #{cityId}
